Subject: WhiteWater renewal — accelerated segmentation & standby cluster request

Hi Alice,

Hope you had a smooth week. Quick note as we approach your July renewal window: you mentioned in last week's call that the analytics team needs an isolated analytics cluster (VPC-carved) plus two standby clusters for failover during your Q3 migration. We sketched two pragmatic paths that keep the cutover timeline tight while minimizing disruption to the existing footprint.

High-level options (attached is a line-item pricing workbook and a draft SOW):
- Option A — 12 month renewal + +2 isolated clusters (analytics) + 2 standby nodes: modest uplift, 10% renewal credit applied to hosted fees; target go-live: 2027-07-05.
- Option B — 24 month commitment + +4 clusters (2 analytics, 2 standby), expanded monitoring retention and priority handling: deeper unit discount (18%) and waived onboarding fee; target go-live: 2027-07-05.

Questions for you:
1) Which option aligns with WhiteWater's procurement appetite (12 vs 24 months)?
2) Do you need us to include a short-term SLA exception for standby nodes until capacity is fully provisioned?
3) Any additional compliance artifacts — SOC2 or data-residency notes — we should surface up front for your Security/Procurement teams?

Timing: To meet a July 5 cutover we need signed order by 2027-06-14 to allow sequencing and VPC peering setup. I've attached a draft SOW and pricing workbook for your review.

Connor and I can hop on a quick 30m call to walk the options and dependencies; propose Thurs 6/3 at 10am PT if that works.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the options and the quick turnaround. We are interested in pursuing an accelerated plan but a few items before we loop Finance:

- Can you provide a per-cluster cost breakdown (CapEx-equivalent and monthly run rate) and call out any one-time onboarding fees? The workbook you attached is helpful but procurement wants a single-line monthly and an ARR view.
- Security ask: we will need a brief note confirming that the isolated analytics cluster will remain in our VPC (not multi-tenant) and a pointer to the SOC2 artifact. Procurement will also want an audit window for logs (30 vs 90 days).
- Regarding terms: we prefer not to extend to 24 months unless the price delta is compelling. If you can land within a 12-month uplift with demonstrated discounts + standby pricing, that will likely be easier for approvals.

We can do the 6/3 call but need Connor and your infra PM on the line to talk VPC-peer, routing, and expected lead times for peering/MPLS if relevant.

Thanks — I can confirm internal availability if you propose 2 times.

Best,
Alice

Timeline: customer needs signed order by 2027-06-14 to keep the go-live. I've attached the draft SOW again and a quick pricing view that maps to the workbook.
